task: Fix 3 bugs found by adversarial review of the uncommitted "Suggest from voice qualities" recording-guide feature

frontend/src/pages/Voices/VoicesPage.tsx.summary: Fixed editingVoiceMetadata: was matching the currently-open Script Editor profile via `group.profiles.includes(state.editingProfile)` reference-equality, which silently went stale whenever any unrelated refetchHome() (any job_completed/queue_paused websocket event app-wide) replaced speakerProfiles with new object references. Extracted the resolution into an exported pure function `resolveEditingVoiceMetadata(editingProfile, voiceGroups, voiceMetadataMap, voiceMetadataList)` that matches on the stable `profile.name` primitive (same key already used by handleUpdateSettings/rename/reset-test-text elsewhere in this file) instead of object identity.

app/api/routers/chapters.py.summary: PUT /api/segments/{segment_id} now enforces an explicit field whitelist (SEGMENT_UPDATE_ALLOWED_FIELDS = character_id, speaker_profile_name, audio_status, text_content) before forwarding the request body into update_segment(**updates), which otherwise used untrusted request-supplied dict keys directly as SQL column names. Unknown fields now 400 rather than passing through silently.

flow_impact: No flow/invariant shape change: VoicesPage.tsx fix keeps the exact same id-first/name-fallback resolution convention as handleEditMetadata (INV-4's ScriptEditor 'Suggest from voice qualities' gating is unaffected, just no longer reference-equality-fragile). chapters.py fix narrows PUT /segments/{id}'s accepted body to the four fields the frontend (frontend/src/api/index.ts updateSegment type) and all other real callers of update_segment's HTTP-facing path already use — no legitimate caller sends a field outside this set today.
tests_added: frontend/tests/unit/pages/Voices/VoicesPage.test.tsx: resolveEditingVoiceMetadata describe block — regression for the stale-reference bug (rebuilt voiceGroups array, same values/different object identity) plus not-found and name-fallback cases.
tests/api/test_api_chapters.py: test_chapter_segments_sync_and_update extended — PUT /api/segments/{id} with an unexpected extra key now asserts 400 and that no partial update was applied.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Voices/components/metadata/recordingPromptSuggester.tieAndThresholds.test.ts (new file): tie-break (first-in-array wins on equal scores) and CLOSE_THRESHOLD=6 / EXACT_THRESHOLD=10 boundary-inclusive behavior for suggestRecordingPrompt, using a mocked recordingArchetypes fixture (recordingArchetypes.ts itself untouched).
